channel.title: The Claudia Winkleman Show
channel.desc: Claudia is joined by actor Phil Dunster, who shot to fame in the hit show Ted Lasso, to talk about his new series, Rooster, on HBO Max; star of stage and screen Cush Jumbo is chatting about the return of the second season of her British crime thriller, Criminal Record; and comedian Josh Widdicombe discusses his podcast, The Museum of Pop Culture.
